adapters.evidence_contract: Project claims and style rules pass before owner acceptance.
Scheduled, executed and measured states carry provider receipts.

first_value.scenario: Research one bounded hypothesis, draft under project rules and prepare one scheduled activity.
first_value.expected_outcome: Terminal run with edited content and a pending or completed activity receipt; correctness remains owner-open.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: Owner reads the terminal research-to-activity result; acceptance correctness remains open until explicit feedback.

presets.substitution_metric: Count project activities whose state no longer has to be reconciled manually between plan, calendar and result.
migration_notes: Import existing text rules and claims once; do not create a role or document per campaign.

presets.profile_role: Business founder operating several Web projects

adapters.evidence_contract: Use registered language checks; Ruby projects declare their own test command without claiming a built-in semantic graph.

first_value.scenario: Register one bounded Web project, install an owned hook and complete one known repository task.
first_value.expected_outcome: Project registration, route, checks and hook transaction finish without editing platform core.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A bounded known repository task reaches its expected deterministic checks on one selected project.

presets.substitution_metric: Number of duplicated per-project workflow rules and manual setup steps removed after onboarding.
migration_notes: Migrate one project first and preserve each repository's local rules and commands.

presets.profile_role: 1C development lead diagnosing source and live information-base behavior

adapters.evidence_contract: Diagnostics are compared with an accepted revision-bound baseline.
Live information-base facts return as validated external evidence with resource identity and completeness.

first_value.scenario: Diagnose a known issue whose missing fact exists only in a registered test information base.
first_value.expected_outcome: The same run waits in external_evidence_required, consumes the validated packet and reaches the known diagnosis.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A private known diagnosis resumes after test-base evidence without replaying completed model calls.

presets.substitution_metric: Count pending diagnosis sessions replaced by typed external-evidence requests that later resume automatically.
migration_notes: Register existing BSL wrappers as project commands before replacing any local process.

presets.profile_role: Principal data analyst working with SQL, Python and ClickHouse

adapters.evidence_contract: Queries execute against an isolated or explicitly read-only boundary.
Expected zero-row, count, reconciliation or schema result is recorded deterministically.

first_value.scenario: Run a private known reconciliation invariant and preserve only hashes, metrics and provenance in receipts.
first_value.expected_outcome: The deterministic invariant reaches the known result without persisting SQL rows or prompts.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: Private reconciliation result equals the pre-existing known answer on the authorized data copy.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manual reconciliation notes replaced by reproducible invariant receipts.
migration_notes: Keep corporate data and query results outside public fixtures and persistent prompts.

presets.profile_role: 1C technical director with an established workflow and NDA constraints

adapters.evidence_contract: Read-only source diagnostics retain hashes and bounded metrics.
Persistent receipts contain no source, prompt or secret samples.

first_value.scenario: Audit one bounded source question with redacted receipts and measured byte budgets.
first_value.expected_outcome: Terminal factual report with no persisted source; correctness remains owner-open.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: Owner reads the terminal NDA-safe audit and decides whether it preserves the established guarantees.

presets.substitution_metric: Number of local context-compaction and receipt-redaction mechanisms no longer maintained separately.
migration_notes: Adopt only donor mechanisms that remove maintenance; do not replace the existing workflow wholesale.

presets.profile_role: Founder maintaining several Ruby Web products on macOS

adapters.evidence_contract: Registered project checks provide the language truth without a claimed built-in Ruby graph.
Install, hook, run and rollback evidence names the exact macOS and tool versions.

first_value.scenario: Complete one small repository change with pause and resume on macOS.
first_value.expected_outcome: Terminal run with visible receipts and no cross-project configuration inheritance; correctness remains owner-open.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: Owner reads one real terminal result and evaluates whether the portfolio workflow is useful.

presets.substitution_metric: Count duplicated workflow files and manual stop/resume bookkeeping removed across the portfolio.
migration_notes: Start with one repository; preserve project-specific rules instead of centralizing them blindly.

presets.profile_role: 1C team lead implementing contract-first pure functions

adapters.evidence_contract: BSL diagnostics run before commit against a revision-bound baseline.
Pure-function fixture result is deterministic and names the tested contract.

first_value.scenario: Implement one pure BSL function against an anonymized input/output fixture.
first_value.expected_outcome: The fixture and BSL diagnostics pass before any commit or release approval.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A contract-first function matches its owner-authored known fixture result.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manual pre-commit validation steps replaced by one registered command and receipt.
migration_notes: Keep the human-authored function contract authoritative; automate only execution and evidence.

presets.profile_role: 1C developer working with full ERP source exports

adapters.evidence_contract: Enumeration proves scope pushdown, completeness and target visibility beyond legacy limits.

first_value.scenario: Find a relevant module intentionally placed after historical enumeration limits in a large source export.
first_value.expected_outcome: The module is found and every negative claim retains authoritative per-scope completeness.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: The known module in the private ERP export is visible with an honest corpus boundary.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manual searches needed after the platform proves complete scoped enumeration.
migration_notes: Do not solve large corpora by raising prompt limits; enumerate authoritatively and select evidence semantically.

presets.profile_role: 1C platform co-founder with an isolated GUI test runtime

adapters.evidence_contract: Executor results are signed and bound to run, step, request and checkpoint hashes.
Actions run only in the registered isolated information base and return typed evidence.

first_value.scenario: Send one known isolated GUI test request and return its signed result as canonical evidence.
first_value.expected_outcome: The original run resumes only after signature, resource and completeness validation.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: The pre-existing isolated test reproduces its known result through the external protocol.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manual runtime resume commands replaced by signed request/result delivery.
migration_notes: Keep the existing Runtime and GUI tester external; register it rather than porting it into Zodchi.

presets.profile_role: DevOps engineer operating CI, incidents, access and backup systems

adapters.evidence_contract: Read-only inventory and health checks run before any proposal.
Generated settings retain foreign ownership and use merge or proxy mode.

first_value.scenario: Run read-only incident inventory and produce a bounded proposal without changing generator-owned settings.
first_value.expected_outcome: Two-step terminal diagnosis with preserved settings ownership and no unapproved action.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A known read-only investigation reproduces its facts while the existing generator remains authoritative.

presets.substitution_metric: Count incident and access handoff stages removed without weakening rollback or health evidence.
migration_notes: Use two base modes; add proposal, dry-run and approval only when risk requires them.

presets.profile_role: 1C educator and developer with a finite-state delivery pipeline

adapters.evidence_contract: The known fixture result and deployment checkpoint are deterministic.
Owner approval binds objective, plan, checkpoint and exact action hashes.

first_value.scenario: Prepare a synthetic known-answer 1C release and invalidate approval after any checkpoint change.
first_value.expected_outcome: Unchanged action proceeds after approval; changed action creates a replacement approval and does not execute.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: The owner's private reference task reaches the pre-existing known result with hash-bound approval.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manual approval-state updates replaced while preserving exact scenario binding.
migration_notes: Compare against the existing state machine; replace only coordination work, not its delivery guarantees.

presets.profile_role: Unity founder operating an established production pipeline on macOS

adapters.evidence_contract: Definitions and references carry an attested Unity solution boundary; incomplete callers remain unknown.
Process, memory, PID, project path and process-tree cancellation guards wrap the run.
Exact Git checkpoint and LFS hydration precede Unity evidence.

first_value.scenario: Audit one completed iteration read-only and preserve separate scope and milestone verdicts.
first_value.expected_outcome: Technical findings and owner playtest status remain separate; no write or release action occurs.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A completed private iteration produces the same accepted technical boundaries before a small write canary.

presets.substitution_metric: Frequency of manual iteration-state edits after Zodchi owns coordination while existing Unity guards remain.
migration_notes: Do not replace the production pipeline; attach its guards and receipts as project adapters.

presets.profile_role: Web-game founder combining design consistency and press outreach

adapters.evidence_contract: Prototype state and screenshots are deterministic and tied to the feature objective.
Outreach identities and execution receipts prevent duplicate contact.

first_value.scenario: Produce deterministic browser proof for one feature or complete one deduplicated outreach cycle.
first_value.expected_outcome: Terminal technical or execution evidence is readable by the owner; product correctness remains open.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: Owner reads one real terminal prototype or outreach result before any domain acceptance claim.

presets.substitution_metric: Count repeated manual pipeline and outreach bookkeeping steps removed while preserving design and copy review.
migration_notes: Keep game verdict, content verdict and release verdict as separate gates.

presets.profile_role: Indie Unity developer maintaining a large risk-sensitive repository

adapters.evidence_contract: Semantic definitions and references use a complete or explicitly partial Unity project boundary.
A target after historical limits remains visible under source scope.

first_value.scenario: Diagnose a known large-repository defect whose target lies after historical enumeration limits.
first_value.expected_outcome: The target and semantic references are found without converting a partial boundary into missing.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A private known defect is reproduced at the expected source locations with bounded risk-oriented evidence.

presets.substitution_metric: Growth of manual pending task logs after bounded diagnosis and evidence selection are enabled.
migration_notes: Preserve the existing risk-oriented verification policy and fix only coordination and search limits.

presets.profile_role: Successful indie Unity developer using MCP and deterministic simulations

adapters.evidence_contract: Semantic anchors complement the registered MCP graph without claiming caller completeness.
MCP discovery is used first when registered and its version and boundary enter evidence.
Seed, inputs, output artifact hashes and run count make the simulation reproducible.

first_value.scenario: Analyze one save or lifecycle question using MCP-first discovery or a deterministic balance simulation.
first_value.expected_outcome: The known simulation or lifecycle evidence is reproducible and any missing caller edge stays unknown.

private_acceptance.expected_contract: A private known simulation or lifecycle query reproduces its established result and evidence boundary.

presets.substitution_metric: Count manually assembled navigation and simulation evidence artifacts replaced by reproducible receipts.
migration_notes: Use the existing MCP graph as a registered provider; do not make it a mandatory runtime dependency.
